<thought>To identify the template that, when applied to the target molecule, yields the given precursors, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates whose forward reaction forms a carbon‑carbon double bond and an ester, and breaks C‑P, C‑C and C‑O bonds – characteristic of the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction. This should return the appropriate template and its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-C", "C-O"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C", "ester"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
